title: Revive or archive intentvision: settle the dormant backlog and decide the project's future
description: IntentVision is a Universal Prediction Engine (connect sources -> normalize metrics -> forecast/anomaly -> explain -> alert/API/dashboard/agent), an npm-workspaces TypeScript monorepo (contracts/pipeline/operator/api/sdk/web/agent packages + Terraform infrastructure/ + ADK agents). Dormant since last commit 2026-04-30. Backlog Zero Wave 0 (2026-07-02) settled all 67 non-closed beads: 36 closed with evidence (Phase 4/8/12/13 SaaS control plane, billing, notifications, observability code all shipped Dec 2025 but beads were left open; Phase G apps/ restructure closed as never-adopted), 20 deferred to 2026-10-01 (load testing, DR/backups, monitoring baseline, web tests, Turso Cloud setup - real remaining work), 11 kept open as needs-human (GCP Cloud Run/Agent Engine deploy cluster obsolete-as-written under the GCP exodus policy; Agent Assist pricing + customer user journeys are business decisions). A revival needs: (1) Jeremy's decision on the needs-human items (platform re-scope to the Contabo VPS vs archive), (2) re-scoping GCP-bound ops beads (Cloud Run, Firestore, Secret Manager, Agent Engine) to the VPS stack, (3) picking up the deferred ops-readiness work, (4) closing or merging stale PRs #1 and #6. Full manifest: 000-docs/078-AA-AUDT-backlog-zero-revival-manifest-2026-07-02.md

GitHub: jeremylongshore/intent-vision#9 — https://github.com/jeremylongshore/intent-vision/issues/9. MIRROR RULE: bd-sync handles fan-out — `bd-sync note intentvision-3pt` and `bd-sync close intentvision-3pt` mirror to GH and Plane automatically.

title: Phase G: Production Scaffold Restructure
description:
Major scaffold restructure to production-ready SaaS architecture.

TARGET STRUCTURE:
- apps/api: Cloud Run production API (Express/Fastify)
- apps/web: Firebase Hosting dashboard (React/Vite/Tailwind)
- packages/contracts: Shared types/interfaces
- packages/pipeline: Core prediction engine
- packages/operator: Multi-tenant auth layer
- packages/agent: AI agent tools (optional)
- packages/sdk-js: Public JavaScript SDK for customers
- infra/: Deployment configs (Cloud Run, Firebase, env)
- scripts/: Organized into ci/, dev/, ops/
- db/: SQL schema (unchanged)

SEPARATION GUARANTEE:
- .agentfs/ and .beads/ remain internal dev-only
- Product code never imports from internal tools
- SQL is source of truth; Firestore optional for UI state

OUTCOME: Clean multi-tenant SaaS with customer-facing API, dashboard, and SDK.
